2	Event Scale: 6 to 14 teams.
3	Buy-in and prize payouts are split evenly among team members.
4	The top two teams will make the ITM.
	
1	初赛包含三场不同类型的锦标赛（限注/大注/玩家选择），每场锦标赛每队各派一名队员参加。
2	比赛开始时和重新分桌时，按钮位从1号位开始。
3	起始筹码为 50,000。
4	25秒限时行动规则将在比赛开始时适用。玩家在比赛开始时获发4张加时卡。
5	每当按钮位经过发牌员，游戏项目更换。
6	每支队伍拥有3张换人卡，比赛进行至最后3人之前，可自由更换场上队员。
7	每支队伍拥有3张暂停卡，每张卡可暂停60秒与队员进行讨论。
8	每支队伍拥有1张复活卡，第一次休息后，仍未使用的复活卡将作为 40,000 筹码增加至该队伍的任意一位玩家的筹码中。
9	玩家将根据完赛名次获得相应的分数，队伍的分数为三名队员分数的总合。
10	三场比赛的名次和积分均不可进行协商或转让。
11	三场比赛结束后，积分最高的四支队伍晋级半决赛。
12	若多队出现同分状况，将通过比较三场赛事中队伍之间的胜负关系确定排名。
13	如以上方法无法确定最终排名（例如：三支队伍在三场比赛中的名次全部相同），在 Dealer’s Choice 比赛中获得最高分数的队伍晋级。
1	The preliminary round consists of 3 different types of tournaments (Fixed Limit / Big Bet / Dealer‘s Choice), with each team represented by one player in each event.
2	The button starts in Seat 1 at the beginning of the tournament and whenever tables are redrawn.
3	The starting stack is 50,000.
4	A 25-second shot clock will be implemented from the start of the tournament. Players will receive 4 Time Bank cards at the beginning.
5	The game changes each time the button passes the dealer.
6	Each team has 3 Sub cards. Teams may freely substitute players at the table until only 3 players remain in the tournament.
7	Each team has 3 Time-out cards, with each card allowing a 60-second pause for team discussions.
8	Each team has 1 Revive card. If the card remains unused after the first break, it will be converted into 40,000 chips and added to the chip stack of any player on that team.
9	Players will receive points based on their finishing positions. The team points is the sum of the points earned by all three players.
10	The rankings and points from the three tournaments cannot be negotiated or transferred.
11	Upon completion of the three tournaments, the four teams with the highest total points will advance to the semifinals.
12	If multiple teams are tied in points, rankings will be determined by comparing their head-to-head results across the three tournaments.
13	If the above method still cannot determine the final rankings (e.g., three teams finish in the exact same positions across all three tournaments), the team with the highest number of points earned in the Dealer‘s Choice event will advance.

1	The semifinals/final consists of 7 heads-up matches, where the first team to win 4 rounds win the match  (best-of-seven format).
2	Both teams will alternately select 5 games in order (the team with the higher preliminary ranking has the priority choice of picking order).
3	Each team bans 1 game from the opposing team.
4	Each team fields 3 players to play 3 heads-up matches simultaneously for Rounds 1–3 (the team with the lower preliminary ranking must submit their lineup first).
5	After Rounds 1–3, the trailing team bans 1 of their opponent's games. Both teams then field 3 players to play 3 heads-up matches simultaneously for Rounds 4–6 (both teams submit their lineups simultaneously).
6	If the teams are tied 3–3 after the first 6 rounds, a 7th round will be played, with each team fielding 1 player (both teams submit their lineups simultaneously).
7	At the start of each heads-up match, each player chooses 1 game, resulting in a 2-game mixed heads-up duel.
8	The starting chip stack is 100,000, and the game type rotates every 5 hands.
9	A 20-second shot clock rule applies from the start of the match. Each player is issued 4 Time Bank Cards at the beginning of each round.
10	Each team has a total of 3 Time-out cards.
